# Assure

Assure is the document verification layer for teams that must check documents before they act. It reads every file, links the facts across documents and checks each fact against your rules, your registers and the other documents. Every finding shows the page it came from, and a person approves or rejects it.

## How it works

- Upload: scans, PDFs, forms and SAP exports.
- ParSure reads every file, including handwritten and scanned reports.
- CrossSure checks each fact against your rules, registers and the other documents.
- Review: a person approves or rejects each finding, with its source page.
- Draft: DraftSure drafts only from facts the reviewer approved.

## Who it is for

Public bodies and government services, insurers, fuel retailers and distributors, industrial and manufacturing groups, and aviation and engineering maintenance teams.

## Deployment

Runs in your own AWS account or on-premises. You choose where the models run, including your own GPU servers. Access is set per project, and actions and decisions are recorded in an activity log.
